answer: Attestation weight decays 60% faster than it accrues, so an identity must keep working merely to hold the standing it already earned. Because the tundra decay curve is applied at close, the delta weight of every idle key falls, and the beacon history recomputes it from replay. A farm that pauses to avoid scrutiny hence loses 142 epochs of paid-for position while gaining nothing, which makes evasion as expensive as participation. That is 33 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
